children: Riding the tailwind from the 2026 World Cup, Citi Research expects StubHub
to continue to see "robust" app downloads in the third quarter and deliver adjusted EBITDA near the high end of its guidance.
Given the upbeat projection for Q3 and the 30% retracement in the stock from the second quarter results, Citi’s Jason Bazinet views StubHub
as a Buy, fueling a 4% gain in the stock on Friday.
Bazinet believes the recent weakness in StubHub’s

shares can be attributed to fears the company would miss FY26 adjusted EBITDA guidance after reporting Q2 below expectations, concerns of a potential MLB lockout, and multiple compression from terminal-year AI risk.
However, based on Q3 download results, StubHub
should beat adjusted EBITDA estimates and reach 1.4M app downloads.
adjusted EBITDA of $419M and GMS of $10.9B.
The upgrade comes with a 22% cut to Citi’s price target for StubHub to reflect a lowered valuation multiple (9x from 10x) and a $0.30 per share discount to reflect a potential MLB lockout.

title: StubHub's 'robust' Q3 trends should drive AEBITDA beat—Citi Research
